exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection during 2nd and 3rd trimesters of pregnancy
SARS-CoV-2 infection status (positive RT-PCR vs. negative serology)
Pregnant women with positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy, especially among multiparous women, was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were significantly increased among women with a positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2.
